thread:
nina: Quick UX/copy pass on the Alerts panel — the tooltip on the red 'Retry' toast reads "Retry request" but actually triggers a full job restart. Folks are expecting a quick retry of a single request. Proposing change to 'Restart job' with a confirmation dialog.

ryan: Strong yes to clarity. 'Retry' implies idempotent retry. 'Restart job' sets correct expectation. For the confirmation dialog copy, suggest: title 'Restart job?', body 'This will restart the entire job and may rerun tasks. Are you sure?', primary button 'Restart job', secondary 'Cancel'.

sam: Accessibility nit: our current dialog buttons are too close and don't have clear focus order on keyboard. Make sure primary is last in DOM order but visually first (using CSS order) so screen readers announce Cancel then Restart which is odd. Better to keep logical DOM order matching visual. Also add aria-describedby linking to the body paragraph.

nina: Good catch. Also the toast currently shows a link-looking inline action 'Retry' (underlined). Let's switch to a plain button with role=button and aria-label='Restart job'. Update color from pure red #FF3B30 to a slightly darker variant for contrast in light themes (#E02A2A). Sam, can you run contrast?

sam: Ran quick check: #E02A2A on white yields 4.6:1 for 14px bold text — passes. I'll add a fallback 1px border for dark theme where contrast drops.

design-bot: Action items: change toast action text? PENDING. dialog copy updated? NO. focus order fix? NO. @nina please file PR for copy + dialog structure. :robot_face:

nina: Filing small PR now with copy updates, dialog markup change, aria-describedby, and color token tweak. Will request review from @ryan and @sam.

ryan: I'll review for tone and microcopy. Thanks!

sam: I'll check accessibility and contrast in the PR.

nina: Thanks all — closing thread unless someone has more microcopy nits.
